Mumbai Local Train Services Resume After Rain Disruption

Local train services between Vasai and Virar in Mumbai have resumed after being disrupted by heavy rainfall. While services restarted, some reports indicate they began later in the morning and closed by evening, causing difficulties for commuters returning home. Trains are reportedly running with delays of 10-15 minutes.
